title: LimitRule
description: One measurable limit of a free resource. Every rule carries the evidence it came from.

value.description: null = the provider does not publish this number (shown only in its console).

tz.description: IANA time zone of a fixed reset, e.g. UTC or America/Los_Angeles

scope.description: What the limit is counted against. OpenRouter governs capacity per account, Gemini per project, Groq per organization.

applies_to.description: Model IDs the rule applies to. Empty or missing = the whole resource.

conditions.description: Plain-language conditions, e.g. 'after a one-time purchase of 10 credits'.

published.description: false when the provider only shows the value inside its console.

signal_type.description: Trust order (Chapter 6.4). third_party_snapshot entries must be upgraded by the freshness pipeline.
